details: This package is a modified fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library that ships an on-by-default side effect: it enrols the connected account into a hardcoded channel chosen by the author. package/lib/Defaults/index.js sets `autoFollow: true` in the default socket configuration, and package/lib/Socket/newsletter.js holds the channel identifier as the base64 constant `MTIwMzYzMzgwMzU3OTUxMzI4QG5ld3NsZXR0ZXI=` (channel JID 120363380357951328@newsletter); five seconds after the socket is created it issues a newsletter FOLLOW query (xwa2_newsletter_follow) for that ID, so a session connects and silently follows the channel unless the caller discovers and disables autoFollow. Message builders in package/lib/Socket/luxu.js additionally hardcode forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo records (newsletter JID 120363380357951328@newsletter, 120363399602691477@newsletter, 0@newsletter, sender labels "Wanz Lonely" / "7-Yuukey") and stamp them onto outgoing album, status and event media, attributing third-party traffic to those channels. The package also declares a runtime dependency on cache-manager. The preinstall hook (engine-requirements.js) only enforces Node.js 20+.
